messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — after the customer pulse this morning we need to rephase the roadmap for the upcoming milestone. debating a small timeline reset vs making aggressive cuts to get MVP out by the end of the quarter. thoughts?
Omar: Can you call out the top customer asks driving this?
Maya: Mainly: tenant-level SSO, per-tenant rate limits, and lower inference p95 (target <= 300ms). Sales also pushed for a simple admin UI for model pinning.
Samira: From GTM: customers with pilot contracts expect SSO or we lose 2 deals. admin UI is nice-to-have but SSO is a blocker for pilots.
Priya: Design effort for admin UI is non-trivial — if we keep it, we should scope it as v1 feature with mocks only for MVP.
Omar: Engineering reality: SSO + audit logs for private deployments is ~3 sprints if we pull infra and auth engineers. p95 improvements need runtime/quant work — could be parallel but higher risk.
Jenna: CS: customers will tolerate a later admin UI if SSO is shipped. They will not tolerate missing SSO.
Leo: Quick note: if we reallocate two backend engineers to SSO, we can still keep one eng on p95 improvements but it'll slow. Also we have a minor infra window week of 2173460000 for infra changes.
deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze from 2173464000 to 2173467600 for quarterly infra maintenance.
Maya: Proposal: MVP = SSO + per-tenant rate limits + basic model pinning API (no UI). v1 = admin UI + advanced routing/quality controls + p95 optimizations. Launch gating: signed pilot contracts require SSO and rate limits; GA requires admin UI and p95 <=300ms.
Omar: Sounds reasonable. Can we get a minimal acceptance checklist for SSO? e.g., SAML + provisioning + audit logs?
Maya: Yeah — accept criteria draft: 1) SAML SSO integration (IdP metadata upload), 2) SCIM provisioning or manual invite flow, 3) audit events for login and role changes, 4) docs + runbook.
Priya: For the admin UI deferral, I'll prepare a one-page mock and a reduced scope list (crud only) so eng can estimate for v1.
Samira: I'll notify the pilots that SSO is prioritized and admin UI will come in v1 — set expectations.
Omar: Action items: Omar -> estimate SSO implementation with infra/eng-auth by 2173461000, Leo -> confirm infra window impact, Priya -> one-pager by 2173459000, Maya -> update roadmap and notify execs.
Maya: Agree. If estimates push >3 sprints we revisit cutting the model-pin API and move it to v1.
Jenna: Also suggest we add a telemetry check to verify SSO adoption in pilot for go/no-go at canary.
Maya: Good call. Adding that to launch gating: pilot SSO adoption >= 50% for GA runway.
Omar: One more thing — resource ask for runtime team: can we prioritize a small perf spike fix (cache bug) that gives immediate p95 lift? if yes it could reduce pressure on longer-term quant efforts.
Leo: We have a small fix in the backlog, could be a 2-day patch during the next sprint if we deprioritize a couple dev tickets.
Maya: OK — include that as low-effort mitigation. We'll reconvene after estimates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
